title: The Classic Routine
text: In the classic Hot Springs bath routine, the sitz tub is filled to 108 degrees for ten minutes. The full tub is 98 to 100 degrees.

title: Hot Water Jug Fountains
text: Drinking water in the park comes from several hot water jug fountains. Two cold water springs, Happy Hollow and Whittington, are treated using ozone filtration.

title: A Cigar on the Veranda
text: William Pinkerton lost his belongings in the 1923 Arlington fire while smoking a cigar on the veranda. The hotel burned April 5, with a $1.6 million loss.

title: The Alligator Farm
text: H. L. Campbell founded Hot Springs' alligator farm in 1902. He wanted a tourist draw beyond the baths.
source: Wikipedia: Arkansas Alligator Farm and Petting Zoo

title: A Park Built by the CCC
text: Lake Catherine State Park was built in the 1930s by the Civilian Conservation Corps. Three stone-and-wood cabins are on the National Register.

title: Soakers and Water Balloons
text: Teams push bathtubs in a race down Hot Springs' Central Avenue each year. Spectators join in with Super Soakers and water balloons.
source: Visit Hot Springs: 2020 version of the World Championship Running of the Tubs (press release)
